hero.title: Free Markets and Innovation, Sort Of
hero.description: The Journal’s editorial board rejects crypto competition and instead misinterprets Clarity, a pro-innovation, pro-competition, and pro-consumer bill, argues the Blockchain Association's Summer Mersinger.

latest.title: Coldcard hackers transfer 64 BTC and 200 ETH to cryptocurrency mixers
latest.description: Hackers behind the Coldcard exploit transferred millions in digital assets to cryptocurrency mixers, while most stolen funds remained traceable in attacker-controlled wallets.

latest.title: Peloton posts first ever annual net profit, but shares drop as outlook disappoints
latest.description: Peloton delivered its first ever annual profit in fiscal 2026 but it's still working to generate sales growth as consumers pull back on big ticket purchases.

latest.title: Why Sandisk and Western Digital crashed 10% and what it means for bitcoin
latest.description: Strong earnings from SanDisk and Western Digital were not enough to satisfy investors, raising questions about whether capital is beginning to rotate from AI winners into crypto.

latest.title: Hadrian valued at nearly $8 billion after fresh funding as money pours into defense tech
latest.description: Hadrian is one of a number of defense tech startups raising large sums and benefiting from President Trump's plans to upgrade the U.S. military.

latest.title: World's biggest spirits maker pops 6% on $1 billion cost-cutting plan
latest.description: Diageo, whose brands include Johnnie Walker scotch whisky, Captain Morgan rum and Guinness stout, said costs relating to the savings program will amount to $1.2 billion.

latest.title: Versant raises 2026 outlook on strength of platforms segment and advertising momentum
latest.description: Versant noted revenue growth in its platforms business, which includes Fandango and GolfNow, and now, the recent acquisition of Full Swing.

latest.title: JPYC raises $38 million Series B led by major Japanese logistics firm AZ-COM Maruwa
latest.description: The investment brings the company’s total raised to $106 million across seven funding rounds since November 2021.

latest.title: Bitcoin, ether benefit as traders seek safety of largest tokens
latest.description: The two largest cryptocurrencies are the only CoinDesk 20 members in positive territory as altcoins fall out of favor.

latest.title: Situational Awareness returns with $400M investment after nearly collapsing: Report
latest.description: Situational Awareness reportedly made a $400 million investment in an undisclosed company, days after the hedge fund nearly collapsed following July’s AI stock crash.

latest.title: Restaurant Brands International earnings beat as Burger King's U.S. business soars
latest.description: Burger King's U.S. business reported same-store sales growth of 8.5%.

latest.title: U.S. ready to return to ‘commitments,’ Iran says as Strait of Hormuz deal looms
latest.description: Iran denied it was in talks with Washington, despite claims by Trump to the contrary.

latest.title: Google is expanding its AI empire — and losing the people who built it
latest.description: Google’s cloud boom is testing the company's commitment to frontier AI as commercial returns take priority.

latest.title: Ukraine’s military hits one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries in long-range drone attack
latest.description: The Slavneft-Yanos facility in Yaroslavl, which is situated hundreds of miles from the Ukraine border, is one of Russia's biggest oil refineries.

latest.title: Bitcoin AI Security Audit Files 4,962 Findings Across 390 Projects
latest.description: A volunteer group is pointing AI agents at Bitcoin project codebases and says 720 of the issues it has filed are high severity or critical.

latest.title: AstraZeneca may buck a decade of pharma strategy to buy U.S. scale
latest.description: Reports of preliminary talks between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb moved shares and reignited debate over Big Pharma consolidation.

latest.title: Russian president signs crypto law, core rules take effect in 2026
latest.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a crypto law establishing market rules for exchanges, custodians and investors, with core provisions taking effect in September 2026.

latest.title: Khanna to introduce 'Data Center Bill of Rights' as fight over AI power plants heats up
latest.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, who won a competitive primary Tuesday, has endorsed state and local moratoriums on data centers.

latest.title: RWAs buck DeFi slowdown as tokenized assets gain traction: CoinShares
latest.description: Tokenized real-world assets moved beyond issuance as RWA deposits more than tripled to $7.4 billion, while lending and trading activity expanded despite a broader industry slowdown.

latest.title: NFT startup founder charged with misusing funds from $10 million fundraising
latest.description: Federal prosecutors say Taj Tarsha misled backers and used investor funds for personal expenses.
